message.content: {"question": "Knowing that R is the tube radius, L the tube length, η is the fluid viscosity and Δp is the pressure variation to tube ends, the Hagen-Poiseuille equation for the flow rate q is", "options": {"A": "q = - (πR² Δp) / (8η L²)", "B": "q = - (πR⁴ η Δp) / (8 L)", "C": "q = - (πR⁴ Δp) / (8η L)", "D": "q = - (πR² Δp) / (8η L)"}, "correct": "C"}
